report.title: HTML filtering report: {{siteName}}

run.title: Run the HTML filtering report
run.editDescription: Scans the content being edited, with the editWorkspace policy of the site.
run.liveDescription: Scans the published content, with the liveWorkspace policy of the site.

state.never: The report has not run on this site yet. Click "Run report" to scan the content of the site.
state.RUNNING: {{count}} items found so far. The page refreshes when the report ends.
state.DONE: The report scanned the whole site on {{date}} and found {{count}} items.
state.LIMIT_REACHEDTitle: Stopped at the limit on the workspace {{workspace}}
state.LIMIT_REACHED: The report stopped on {{date}} once it found {{max}} items. More content may break the rules.
state.FAILED: The report stopped on an error on {{date}}. The log of the processing node holds the error.

report.alreadyRunning: Only one report runs at a time on the platform. Run the report again once the current one ends.

filters.pathHint: Keeps the rows of the content at this path and under it.
filters.markupHint: Keeps the rows whose markups include this tag or this attribute.

report.empty: The report found no content that breaks the HTML filtering rules.
report.error: An error occurred while reading the report.
report.accessDenied: You do not have the permission to view the HTML filtering report of this site.
